main_text.l: VII. Et contrà Adversarios, Anabapti-
stas nominatim, ac Socinianos, hanc cau-
sam agere solent Orthodoxi. Calvinus in
Institutione lib. 2. cap. 8. §. 33. Anabaptistas
diei Dominicæ observationem impugnan-
tes serio perstringit; notante contrà eos-
dem Cloppenburgio in Gangrænâ Theo-
logiæ Anabaptisticæ, part. 3. cap. 15. Sic
autem ibi disputat Calvinus: Porrò hîc co-
gor esse longior, quòd hodiè ob diem Do-
spiritûs: Plebem Christianam quiritan-
tur in Judaismo foveri, quia retinet ali-
quam dierum observationem. Ego autem
respondeo, citrà Judaismum dies istos à
nobis observari: quia longo intervallo dif-
ferimus in hac parte à Judæis. Non enim
figurari: sed suscipimus, ut remedium
retinendo in Ecclesiâ ordini necessarium.
Atqui Paulus docet, non esse in ejus observatione
judicandos Christianos; quia
sit umbra rei futuræ. Ideò timet, ne inter
Galatas frustrà laborârit; quòd adhuc dies
observarent. Et ad Romanos asserit

page.notes: Quotation marks at the left of lines 9–21 are printed quotation marks of the Calvin passage. Doubtful: "Cloppenburgio" and "Cerimoniam" as printed; "ut Cerimoniam" possibly "Cæremoniam". The catchword "perstitio-" is the start of the next page's word, read as printed.
